metadata.purpose: Complete people entities referenced in executive decision cases

people.name: 佐藤健二
people.title: VP Sales

background.previous_role: Sales Director at Enterprise Software Inc

people.notes: VP Sales who advocated for MegaCorp 20% discount (Akiko negotiated to 15%). Requested ¥30M sales team expansion (Raj approved ¥18M for 6 AEs). Part of marketing-sales alignment tension that Sarah resolved.

people.name: 山田浩
people.title: VP Engineering (Former)
people.notes: Former VP Engineering who left for WorkMax Japan with 40% salary increase. Akiko decided not to counter-offer, promoted internal candidate instead. Remains advisor to NexaTech.

people.name: 田中ユキ
people.title: VP Engineering
people.notes: Promoted to VP Engineering after Hiroshi's departure. Internal promotion was part of Akiko's decision to not counter-offer Hiroshi. Later became one of 2 EMs in Yuki Nakamura's team structure decision.

people.name: 田中健司
people.title: VP Product
people.notes: VP Product who proposed ¥40M AI initiative. Akiko approved ¥12M pilot instead. Later championed measured approach after pilot success.

people.name: 鈴木美穂
people.title: VP Customer Success
people.notes: VP Customer Success involved in production crisis (Akiko's 24-hour maintenance decision). Also advocated for building in-house support system (Yuki chose to buy Intercom).

people.name: 山本武
people.title: CIO
people.notes: CIO of MegaCorp Japan (largest customer). Primary contact during renewal negotiation where MegaCorp requested 20% discount.

people.name: Security Engineer
people.title: Senior Security Engineer
people.notes: On-call security engineer who detected SQL injection breach at 11 PM Friday. Paged CTO Yuki. Advocated for full disclosure to customers.

people.name: Content Team Lead
people.title: Senior Content Manager
people.notes: Led content team experiencing burnout from high-volume content production (3-4 posts/week). Proposed shift to quality over quantity. Thrived after Sarah's decision to focus on premium content.

people.name: Demand Gen Manager
people.title: Demand Generation Manager
people.notes: Demand gen team member who advocated for tactical mid-market campaigns (vs brand transformation). Also part of MQL quality discussions during marketing-sales alignment.

people.name: Brand Strategist
people.title: Senior Brand Strategist
people.notes: Brand strategy team member who advocated for full brand transformation (vs tactical approach) for mid-market expansion. Sarah chose their approach.

people.name: Hiroshi SDR
people.title: SDR Team Lead
people.notes: SDR team lead mentioned in Sarah's Slack communication for achieving 1.2-hour average response time (crushing 2-hour SLA). Part of marketing-sales alignment improvement.

people.name: Miho AE
people.title: Account Executive
people.notes: Top-performing AE mentioned in Raj's analysis of sales team performance (top 25% hit 120% quota). Also mentioned in Sarah's Slack for using research report to close 2 deals.

people.name: Finance Analyst
people.title: Senior Financial Analyst
people.notes: Finance team member who flagged DSO increase from 45 to 78 days during monthly close review. Alert led to Raj's comprehensive working capital management initiative.

people.name: Collections Specialist 1
people.title: Collections Specialist
people.notes: One of 2 collections specialists hired by Raj to improve DSO and implement proactive collections workflow. Hired in October 2024.

people.name: Collections Specialist 2
people.title: Collections Specialist
people.notes: One of 2 collections specialists hired by Raj to improve DSO. ¥8M annual cost for both (¥4M each).

people.name: Hiroshi EM
people.title: Engineering Manager (WorkFlow Team)
people.notes: Promoted to Engineering Manager for WorkFlow team when Yuki restructured org from flat to hybrid (EMs + Staff Engineers). Internal promotion from senior engineer. Codes 30%+ of time.

people.name: Kenji EM
people.title: Engineering Manager (TeamSync Team)
people.notes: Promoted to Engineering Manager for TeamSync team in Yuki's restructuring. Internal promotion. Technical EM who still codes 30%+ time.

people.name: Sato Staff Engineer
people.title: Staff Engineer
people.notes: Promoted to Staff Engineer (IC track) in Yuki's restructuring. Technical leadership without people management. Provides architecture reviews, mentorship, code quality standards.

people.name: Tanaka Staff Engineer
people.title: Staff Engineer
people.notes: Promoted to Staff Engineer (IC track) alongside Sato. Loves IC track - didn't want people management but wanted technical leadership role.

people.name: Kenji Engineer
people.title: Senior Engineer
people.notes: Senior engineer who authored design doc proposing Kafka for notifications service. Yuki pushed back on 'resume-driven development,' suggested RabbitMQ instead. Good learning moment.

people.name: Data Analyst
people.title: Marketing Data Analyst
people.notes: Hired as part of Sarah's content strategy shift to research-based content. Supports quarterly research reports with data analysis and survey design.

people.name: Video Producer
people.title: Video Content Producer
people.notes: Hired for video content production as part of content strategy shift. ¥3M for video production setup. Produces weekly video series.

people.name: DevOps Consultant
people.title: Senior DevOps Engineer (Contractor)
people.notes: External DevOps consultant brought in to help with AWS cost optimization. Helped implement reserved instances, rightsizing, and monitoring.

people.name: Legal Counsel
people.title: Corporate Counsel
people.notes: Company lawyer consulted during SQL injection breach. Advised on Japan Privacy Law requirements. Said notification was 'gray area' but Yuki chose full disclosure anyway.

people.name: Communications Director
people.title: Director of Communications
people.notes: Communications director involved in crisis management. In production bug crisis (Akiko), wanted to control narrative. In pricing crisis (Sarah), wanted cautious legal-approved response (Sarah chose transparency instead).

people.name: Board Member (Series A Lead)
people.title: Board Member
people.notes: Board member from Series A who advocated: 'You're too close to profitability to raise now. Raise from position of strength (profitable) not weakness (need cash).' Raj agreed with this view.

people.name: Board Member (Pro-Fundraise)
people.title: Board Member
people.notes: Board member who advocated for fundraising immediately: 'Market is recovering, we should raise while we can, war chest for growth.' Raj chose to defer.

people.name: Investment Banker
people.title: Managing Director
people.notes: Series C investment bank engaged on retainer (¥5M) as part of Raj's 'fundraising readiness' strategy. Preparing diligence materials and investor cultivation.

people.name: Kazuki Matsuda
people.title: Founder
people.notes: B2B SaaS influencer with 85K LinkedIn followers. Posted viral criticism of NexaTech pricing change. Sarah responded with radical transparency within 2 hours, turned him into advocate.

people.name: Gartner Analyst
people.title: Senior Analyst
people.notes: Gartner analyst covering B2B productivity software market. Cited NexaTech's research in market guide. Part of Sarah's analyst relations program.

people.name: Project Manager at MegaCorp
people.title: Senior Project Manager
people.notes: User at MegaCorp who benefits from NexaTech products. Part of NPS survey that showed 72 score for MegaCorp.

people.name: WorkMax Employee
people.title: Unknown
people.notes: WorkMax employee(s) who fanned flames in LinkedIn pricing crisis comments. Backfired when Sarah responded gracefully, made WorkMax look petty.

people.name: Technical Recruiter
people.title: Principal Recruiter
people.notes: External recruiter who helped with engineering hiring. Mentioned in context of competitive talent market where two key hires fell through.

people.name: Senior Engineer (Departed 1)
people.title: Senior Engineer
people.notes: One of 3 senior engineers who expressed concern about career growth after Hiroshi's departure. Left 3 months after Hiroshi for competitor.

people.name: Senior Engineer (Departed 2)
people.title: Senior Engineer
people.notes: Another engineer who left after Hiroshi's departure. Part of short-term attrition that Akiko's career development program addressed.

people.name: Customer Success Manager
people.title: Senior CSM
people.notes: CSM managing MegaCorp account. Involved in discount negotiation. Also overwhelmed during production bug crisis when 120 customers affected.

people.name: Product Manager (AI Features)
people.title: Senior Product Manager
people.notes: PM who led AI search pilot that Akiko approved for ¥12M (vs ¥40M full initiative). Pilot succeeded, learned valuable lessons about data quality requirements.

people.name: ML Engineer 1
people.title: Senior ML Engineer
people.notes: One of 2 ML engineers hired before AI pilot started. Akiko required hiring them first rather than rushing into project without expertise.

people.name: ML Engineer 2
people.title: Senior ML Engineer
people.notes: Second ML engineer hired for AI pilot. Both ML engineers part of building in-house AI capability vs relying on vendors.
